description_en: Adds one or more virtual service groups under a load balancing instance
description_zh: 添加负载均衡实例下的一个或者多个虚拟服务器组。
kebab_example: aliyun ess attach-vserver-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --vserver-group '[{"LoadBalancerId":"lb-bp1u7etiogg38yvwz0000","VServerGroupAttribute":[{}]}]' --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachVServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides, such as ap-southeast-1. For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属地域的ID，如cn-hangzhou、cn-shanghai，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to add the ECS instances or elastic container instances in the current scaling group to the new virtual service groups.

true: adds the instances.

false: does not add the instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否将当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到新增的虚拟服务器组。

true：添加。

false：不添加。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

fields.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance to which the virtual service group belongs. N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5
fields.help_zh: 虚拟服务器组所属负载均衡实例的ID。N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5
fields.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en:
The port number that Auto Scaling uses when it adds ECS instances or elastic container instances to the virtual service group. Valid values: 1 to 65535. In this parameter:

The first N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.

The second N specifies the virtual service group number under the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 5
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到虚拟服务器组时使用的端口号，取值范围：1~65535。其中：

第一个N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5。

第二个N为负载均衡实例下虚拟服务器组的编号，取值范围：1~5
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The ID of the virtual service group. In this parameter:

The first N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.

The second N specifies the virtual service group number under the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 5
fields.help_zh:
虚拟服务器组的ID。其中：

第一个N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5。

第二个N为负载均衡实例下虚拟服务器组的编号，取值范围：1~5
fields.name: vserver_group_id

fields.help_en:
The weight that Auto Scaling sets when it adds ECS instances or elastic container instances to the virtual service group. Valid values: 0 to 100. In this parameter:

The first N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.

The second N specifies the virtual service group number under the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 5.

Default value: 50
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到虚拟服务器组时设置的权重，取值范围：0~100。其中：

第一个N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5。

第二个N为负载均衡实例下虚拟服务器组的编号，取值范围：1~5。

默认值：50
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The collection of information about the virtual service groups associated with the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组关联的虚拟服务器组的信息集合
parameters.name: vserver_group
